title: AgentK Workflow v2
description: Integrated spec from Claude+OpenClaw+MAGELLAN BLOCKS analysis reports. Source of truth for creating, validating, and executing workflows.

version.description: Schema version. Must be '1.0' or newer for v2 workflows.

workflow_id.description: Programmatic ID (lowercase ASCII + underscore). Used as filename and for sub-workflow references. 3-64 chars.

display_name.description: Human-readable name, may contain Chinese/emoji. Shown in UI.

description.description: What this workflow does and when to use it. Used by semantic matcher.

source.description: Provenance. llm_generated workflows may be promoted; legacy = auto-migrated from older format.

owner.description: For department scope: department_code; for personal: user_id; for system: empty.

patterns.description: Keyword or phrase patterns that trigger this workflow via chat/LINE.

schedule.description: Cron expression (5-field) or simple format like '09:00 weekday'. Empty = no schedule.

global_inputs.description: Required inputs the user must provide at execution time (e.g. query, recipient).

env_requirements.description: OS environment variables this workflow needs (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE).

definitions.description: Explicit variable definitions (used by block editor UI). Each has name/type/source/default.

steps.description: Ordered list of steps. Topological order enforced by Gate 0. Empty array allowed for work-in-progress drafts; execution requires >=1 step (enforced at Gate 1).

on_error.description: Error-handler workflow invoked when the main flow aborts (MAGELLAN BLOCKS エラー時に起動するフローのID).

pass_vars.description: Variable names (incl. system _xxx vars) to hand off to the error workflow.

skill_whitelist.description: If set, only these skills may be used. Applied to LLM one-shot generation.

execution.description: Legacy execution hints (kept for backward compat). Prefer per-step on_fail + top-level constraints.

context.description: Free-form metadata slot. Not used by executor; available to UI/extensions.

promoted_from.description: If workflow was promoted from an LLM one-shot run, the run_id of that execution.

blocks.description: Canvas rendering data (legacy / visual editor). Derived from steps; both kept for compatibility.

type.description: sequential = single skill; parallel = branches run together; sub_workflow = invoke another workflow.

label.description: Optional human-friendly step name for logs.

skill_id.description: For sequential steps: which skill to call (must exist in registry).

input_map.description: Mapping from skill's parameter keys to values/expressions. Values may reference ${variable_name} or ${GLOBAL.NAME}.

output_var.description: Name to assign the skill's result to. Readable by later steps via ${name}.

branches.description: For parallel type: list of sub-steps to execute concurrently.

merge_output_var.description: For parallel type: joined output of all branches.

sub_workflow_id.description: For sub_workflow type: ID of the workflow to invoke.

pass_vars.description: For sub_workflow type: variable names to pass to the called workflow.

on_fail.description: abort = stop whole workflow; retry_once = retry after 2s; continue = log & move on; skip = same as continue but no log.

condition.description: Optional skip condition (e.g. '${summary.length} > 100'). Empty = always run.
